caption:
Swipe for the full story. Trump just rejected every call to slow AI on September 13, and every AI company now has a presidential green light.

Here's what's inside: why this wasn't a surprise, the exact moment someone walked up to Trump and asked him personally to slow AI down, how he responded on the record, what no federal limits on AI actually means for your job and your industry, and what the businesses already running AI understand that everyone else is still figuring out.

The political window for slowing AI just closed. There is no guardrail vote coming, no federal pause, nothing. The companies already moving with AI are now racing with explicit backing from the top.

Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what moving now looks like for your operation.

hook_tournament.why: KILLED EVERY FEDERAL BRAKE hits instantly with visceral shock that stops scrolling faster than any other verb—'YOUR JOB IS NEXT' then makes it personal and scary. [5] is nearly as good with its complete story of who won and lost, but 'GAVE THE GREEN LIGHT' lacks the punch needed at 2am.

hook_sharpen.why: [1] combines shock with clarity—the two-sentence rhythm lets shock land, then hits you with the personal consequence that makes logical sense and drives clicks. [2] hits harder emotionally with 'YOUR JOB IS NEXT' but the compound structure feels slightly clickbaity, which makes tired, skeptical scrollers hesitate before committing to a click.
